lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in an approximate grid posterior to the gill region. These clusters are organized into roughly five horizontal rows, with spatial intervals widening toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a lattice-like structure where the blobs serve as primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs, primarily located toward the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of dark, elongated silhouettes representing commensal organisms is visible in the ventral region beneath the primary flank.
